summary: Luke Badiali reviewed portfolio support with Daniel Reese and Amira Khan. Fernhill has 14 portfolio companies and support is uneven. We agreed onboarding standards, a follow-on approach and asking founders for referrals.

discussion.keyPoints: Daniel said 4 companies get most of the team's time; others hear from Fernhill only at board meetings.
Fernhill reserves 30% of the fund for follow-ons but has used only 12%.
Founders have referred 2 deals in 3 years.

recommendations.recommendation: Run the 100-day plan for every new investment, with a named operating partner.
Offer follow-on funding to the top 4 performing companies before their next external round.
Ask each portfolio founder to host one founder breakfast table a year.
Run a founder net promoter survey every 6 months.

actions.action: Review the follow-on case for the top 4 companies

nextFocus: Model fund economics and deal team costs.
nextPreparation: Daniel to bring management fee income and team costs.

tests.question: How much of the follow-on reserve have we used?
Is offering follow-ons to the top 4 companies agreed?
What are we asking portfolio founders to do?
